desc: Tight exterior framing detail of a pressure-treated free-standing pergola: straight double beams and rafters aligned at a wood post with clean black structural connector hardware and through-bolts.
reuse_notes: Use for pergola beam connections, exterior wood framing, connector inspection, patio structures, and wind-aware backyard improvements. It depicts a generic framing condition, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for engineered connection, footing, span, fastener, wind-load, setback, or permit requirements.
